heading: Training of tribal law enforcement and prosecutorial personnel
lead: The Attorney General, in consultation with the Director of the Office of Tribal Justice, shall carry out a program under which tribal law enforcement officials may receive technical assistance and training to pursue a victim-centered approach to investigating and prosecuting severe forms of trafficking in persons (as defined in section 7102 of title 22).

notes.text: Codification Section was formerly classified to section 20709c of this title prior to renumbering by Pub. L. 117–347.
